title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Wolf Trap, Vienna | 2025
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Filene Center, part of the Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Vienna, Virginia, USA, on 17 June 2025.

It was the fourth show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s 2025 tour. Starr previously performed at the Wolf Trap on 17 July 1995, 21 May 1997, 30 May 2000, 12 June 2014, and 10 and 11 August 2019.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
